title: Agent Certificate
description: The Agent Certificate v0 envelope (Wave-C C6/C1 reconciled rulings, 2026-08-11). Ships under the name 'Agent Certificate' — the rename to 'Agent Build Certificate' was struck ('The owner resolution says ship under the certificate name') — with the mandatory page-one scope box: the title and the build-session scope line are const fields printed 'immediately below it: no deployment identity, deployment binding, drift detection, or deployed-runtime claim' (C6 Ruling 3(v)). STATUS, verbatim and binding: 'Current evidence supports no presently issuable signed v0 certificate. The following is the conditional v0 allowlist after implementation and verifier gates.' Why nothing prints today, verbatim: 'The dedicated ledger does not exist. The dedicated certificate key does not exist. Production signing is unwired. The signed/pinned ring does not exist. Client co-signing is not evidenced. The independent verifier has not been shown to pass. B1c and D6a are unregistered inventions.' Structure: claims are a bounded array of the discriminated Claim|NonClaim family's ClaimV0 (only the seven conditional IDs are representable; tier 4 is unconstructible; every claim requires a PASS verifier and bound evidence); non_claims is a FOURTEEN-item tuple that pins all fourteen mandatory printed NON-claims in order — a certificate printing fewer, more, or reordered non-claims is schema-invalid. Disclosure: all-or-nothing refusal is overturned — 'The certificate must not refuse merely because some data is omitted from its disclosure profile. It must instead identify the profile and state that selective disclosure is not proven' — encoded as the required disclosure_profile with its const selective-disclosure line. Exact version dispatch: verifiers dispatch 'by exact schema major/minor and signed semantics-manifest digest'; 'Old verifiers reject unknown newer versions and digests. They never ignore unknown certificate fields or claims' (C1 Ruling 6) — additionalProperties:false throughout makes unknown-field tolerance unrepresentable. Duplicate claim IDs within the claims array are a compiler rejection (certificate_rejection_v0_schema.json: duplicate_claim); draft-07 cannot express cross-item uniqueness by claim_id, so that single check is compiler-enforced rather than schema-enforced.

schema_version.description: Exact-version wire discriminator; verification dispatches on it plus the signed semantics-manifest digest. An unknown value fails closed.

certificate_title.description: The document title, pinned. 'retain Agent Certificate' (C6 Ruling 3(v), reconciled).

build_session_scope_line.description: The prominent build-session scope line, printed immediately below the title (mandatory page-one scope box, conceded to the proposer).
build_session_scope_line.const: Build-session scope: this certificate concerns a build session, not the deployed agent. It makes no deployment-identity, deployment-binding, drift-detection, or deployed-runtime claim.

ledger_seal_projection.description: The sealed expected-stream projection this certificate's claim B1 (if printed) refers to. Legacy/unsealed sessions are refused issuance, never silently downgraded (C6 Ruling 1, conceded) — the refusal is compiler-enforced (rejection code legacy_or_unsealed_session_refused).

claims.description: The printed claims — possibly empty, since every v0 claim is conditional and 'Current evidence supports no presently issuable signed v0 certificate.' An early certificate has fewer and lower-tier claims, never absent caveats.

non_claims.description: The FOURTEEN mandatory printed NON-claims, tuple-validated in canonical print order: A3, A4, B2, E2, E3, F3, G2, H1, then the six standing non-claims. All fourteen are required; additionalItems:false plus the min/max bounds make omission, addition, and reordering schema-invalid. Non-claims are printed, never implied by absence.

allOf.description: Tier-1 claims require a real client co-attestation: 'tier 1 additionally needs a real client attestation' (C6 tier reality) and 'missing co-attestation should refuse issuance' (conceded). A certificate carrying any tier-1 claim without a co_attestation block is schema-invalid.

BuildSessionSubjectV0.description: The machine-readable build_session subject (conceded to the proposer: 'the mandatory page-one scope box and machine-readable build_session subject'). The certificate is ABOUT a build session and nothing else. This REUSES the orphaned optimization/certificate_subject_schema.json subject-binding SHAPE — a self-describing hash_algorithm carried outside the hashed content, a commitment digest, and exact envelope-version pinning, with that schema's own scope discipline ('It does not certify provenance') restated here for the build session. The full certificate_subject RECORD is deliberately NOT embedded: its config_id is a caller-chosen string (bounded at 128 chars but otherwise free), and embedding it would open a user-controlled free-text channel into a certificate record, which the boundary rule forbids ('certificate and registry records contain no user-controlled free-text fields'). The reuse is therefore of the shape's constituent normative definitions (hash_algorithm) and its binding pattern, not of the whole record; binding to an evaluated configuration is a later compatible release once its disclosure is Register-approved. SCOPE, stated so it is not over-read: this subject identifies WHICH build session the certificate concerns. It does not certify the session's provenance, contents, or completeness.

hash_algorithm.description: The algorithm under which session_commitment_digest was computed — reused from the certificate-subject shape's single normative definition so a subject can never be compared across algorithms; an unknown value fails closed.

build_session_ref.description: Opaque build-session reference; MUST match ledger_seal_projection.build_session_ref (compiler-checked equality; cross-field equality is not expressible in draft-07 across $ref boundaries).

session_commitment_digest.description: Canonical commitment digest binding the subject to the sealed session content.

SemanticsBindingV0.description: The signed semantics reference for exact-version dispatch (C1 Ruling 6): the semantics manifest 'binds canonical schema definitions, claim templates, prohibited register, verifier catalog, tier semantics, signature scope, and canonicalization rules.' Each digest names one pinned, signed, ARCHIVED artifact — 'A digest without an archived, authentic bundle and resolver does not preserve verification', so archives and trust-manifest authority are B5/verifier obligations recorded here as scope.

prohibited_register_digest.description: Digest of the pinned prohibited-claims register (P-1…P-40 plus the merged Wave-C additions once deduplicated and re-pinned; a register change that would reject a previously-emitted claim is a MAJOR version event).

DisclosureProfileV0.description: The disclosure profile identification required by the overturned all-or-nothing rule: identify the profile and state that selective disclosure is not proven (G2 is simultaneously a mandatory printed non-claim).

selective_disclosure_line.const: Data omitted from this disclosure profile is simply absent; selective disclosure is not proven.
